caption: The video showcases a false-color thermal view of a spout above a round purple bowl against a warm yellow background. A thin stream of cold liquid descends from the spout into the bowl, continuing throughout the excerpt without visibly starting or stopping, though it thins and breaks intermittently. Vertical temperature readouts beside the bowl's left rim change values, with the upper reading fluctuating, while the lower reading shifts to and holds at -30.1°C. Inside the bowl, the coldest dark blue region gradually expands, consuming the lighter magenta disc that surrounds a dark comma-shaped mark. The bowl's rim stays unchanged, and the spout and background remain fixed with no camera movement. By the final frames, the dark area fills most of the interior, leaving only a small magenta crescent.
